newsitem.title: UK: United UAL cargo and passenger traffic up.
newsitem.headline: United UAL cargo and passenger traffic up.

text.p: UAL Corp Corp's United Airlines said it flew 206 million cargo tonne miles during September or 7.7 percent more than a year ago.
In a press release received here United said this brought cumulative cargo miles for Jan-Sept to 1,733 million or up 3.7 percent from the same period last year.
United said its totaal scheduled revenue passenger miles (RPMs) in September were 2.9 percent above year ago figures.
The carrier said it had a systemwide load factor of 71.7 percent in September with its trans-Atlantric load factor reaching 87.2 percent.
